page_title: BAY 5-0 HAM | Bayern Munich v Hamburger SV 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+2' The foul by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
90' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
89' Fabio Balde (Hamburger) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
88' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

88' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich). Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a direct free kick.
86' A yellow-coloured card is received by Miro Muheim (Hamburger).

85' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
84' 12:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

82' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
80' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
78' The foul by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) was seen by Tobias Stieler who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Hamburger SV are awarded the free kick.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) is replacing Ransford Konigsdorffer.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Luis Diaz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Here is a change. Fabio Vieira is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Balde (Hamburger).

76' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
75' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayern Munich.
73' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
72' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

72' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Hamburger SV win a corner.

71' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
70' Referee Tobias Stieler sees the trip by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.

67' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) latched on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately slams the ball towards the top right corner. His effort was thwarted by the alert goalkeeper, who pulled off a stunning save. Bayern Munich get a corner.
65' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul after Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) hacks down one of his opponents. Bayern Munich get a free kick.
64' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Harry Kane will be replaced by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich).
63' A substitution has been made. Raphael Guerreiro is replaced by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich).
62' 5 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' PENALTY APPEAL after Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
58' Flag up against Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
54' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. Free kick. Bayern Munich will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
54' The percentage of ball possession is – 67:33.
49' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

47' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Manuel Neuer has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich). He is replaced by Raphael Guerreiro.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) comes off for Nicolas Jackson.
46' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jonas Meffert comes on the pitch for Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger).
46' Merlin Polzin makes a switch. Rayan Philippe is coming on in place of Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Merlin Polzin gives a chance to Daniel Elfadli and Aboubaka Soumahoro (Hamburger) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 8:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
43' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

41' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Daniel Heuer Fernandes is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.

39' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
37' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is caught offside!

36' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Hamburger SV in a dangerous position.
34' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Stieler had a clear view and blows his whistle. Bayern Munich will take a free kick near the side line.

31' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
29' Goal! Joshua Kimmich passes the ball to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Daniel Heuer Fernandes couldn't do anything about it. 4:0.
28' The resulting corner from Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
26' 3 - 0 Goal! Daniel Heuer Fernandes gets a hand on the penalty from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
25' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
25' The Bayern Munich players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

23' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayern Munich players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
22' Aboubaka Soumahoro (Hamburger) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
22' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

22' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
20' The referee blows his whistle as Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in his challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Hamburger SV.
19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
18' A snap shot by William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Manuel Neuer produces a good save to thwart him.
16' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hamburger SV.
14' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.

13' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
9' 2 - 0 Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
6' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
3' 1 - 0 Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass just outside the box and produces a glorious strike into the roof of the net off the bar. The goalkeeper was helpless.
2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
1' Aboubaka Soumahoro (Hamburger) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hamburger SV will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
